sup:70510.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Price adjustment from 01 January 2027 – part:350011
move.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining the copper movement. We note that your letter (doc:20260914-70510-P02) passes on 6.5 % to us.

Our 2026Q3 scorecard (sc:70510@2026Q3) records 90.4 % OTD and 273 ppm, so a full pass-through is difficult to justify today.

To keep this a stable partnership we propose the packages below. Could you also send a cost breakdown, your earliest lead time for part:350011, and any cheaper variants?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We have noted your quality scorecard; however, these figures do not warrant a reduction in our pricing. Furthermore, our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We are agreeable to your proposal to introduce the CU-NOTATION index clause to transparently manage material cost fluctuations. With this index clause in place, our current offer stands at a price of €348.39 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Price adjustment from 01 January 2027 (part:350011)
move.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for the revised Angebot. We accept the CU-NOTATION clause as the right tool for stable, transparent pricing, and we would like to keep the base price at the prior level rather than the 6.5 % requested in doc:20260914-70510-P02.

Our 2026Q3 scorecard (sc:70510@2026Q3) records 90.4 % OTD and 273 ppm, so a base price near the previous level is reasonable for both sides.

Please find our packages below. Could you also confirm your earliest lead time for part:350011, the copper share behind your request, and any cheaper variants?

Mit freundlichen Grueßen
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.subject: Ihr Angebot offer:70510-2 – Zahlungsziel und Preisstabilität
move.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for offer:70510-2 at €348.39 with the CU-NOTATION clause and a 5 % deadband; we accept that structure as the basis for stable, transparent pricing.

One item no longer fits our history: our running contract ctr:4600070510 carries 90-day payment terms, while your new offer states 30 days. Restoring 60 days would keep the commercial frame stable across the year-end changeover.

Please find our packages below. Could you confirm which payment terms you can support for part:350011?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company. We can support your request for 60-day payment terms to align with your commercial frame. To accommodate this extension, we must adjust the unit price to €350.32.

Our updated Angebot stands at a price of €350.32 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 60 days net, and a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Price adjustment from 01 January 2027 – offer:70510-3
move.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for offer:70510-3 at €350.32 with 60-day terms. We accept the CU-NOTATION clause with a 5 % deadband as the right foundation for stable, transparent pricing.

Because the clause's base month 2026-08 already reflects today's copper level, the fixed base should remain at €348.32 rather than the 6.5 % requested in doc:20260914-70510-P02. Our 2026Q3 scorecard (sc:70510@2026Q3) shows 90.4 % OTD and 273 ppm, so keeping that base makes the coming year predictable for both sides.

Our packages are below. Could you confirm your earliest lead time for part:350011 and whether a 3 % deadband would change the base price?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company. We have already taken that quality record data into account. We have reviewed your latest proposal; however, the scorecard and notice period data you cited were already factored into our previous calculation, and the offer referenced is our own.

To accommodate your request for a lower base price, we can offer a price of €349.36 per unit if we adjust the payment terms to Zahlungsziel 45 days net, accompanied by a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. Please provide verifiable new data if you wish to justify further adjustments. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

This Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
